name: Daisuki na Boku Dake no Kii-chan
original_name: だいすきなぼくだけのきいちゃん
source:
The protagonist Madoka is living a plain yet peaceful school life with her lover Kiichi. 

But one night, Madoka is r*ped by Kiichi's childhood friend, Chihiro. 
On the next day, Kiichi starts to act weird... 
Although worried, Madoka worries about Kiichi. Then one day she sees... 

An "NTR" (cucking) themed BL novel game. 
The protagonist's lover who is a "top" is cucked as a "bottom". 
Please be warned if you are not comfortable with NTR, cheating, and love triangles. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE228200/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公圆香与恋人纪一过着平凡而平静的校园生活。

但某夜，圆香遭到纪一的青梅竹马千寻强奸。
第二天，纪一开始表现得很奇怪……

圆香虽然担心，却更在意纪一。某天，她看见了……

一款以“NTR”（戴绿帽）为主题的BL小说游戏。
主人公这位作为“攻”的恋人，被作为“受”戴了绿帽。
如果你无法接受NTR、出轨和三角恋，请谨慎游玩。

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE228200/]DLsite English[/url]）
